title: AION 2 Wings: Unlock Flight, Compare Stats and Get Wings
description: Unlock AION 2 wings through the early story, learn PC flight controls, distinguish equipped and owned effects, and check Blazing Sun cosmetic restrictions.
summary: Learn how to unlock flight, find a wing’s acquisition route, compare equipped and collection effects, and choose appearance separately from combat bonuses.
quickAnswer: Continue the opening story through your first Daeva Ascension, then open Wings with Alt+C. Equipped effects come from the pair you wear; owned effects stay active from your collection. Use V for flight and check your current key bindings. Blazing Sun is a Founder cosmetic.
